text.body: ॥ viśveśvarāṣṭakam ॥ gaṅgātaraṅgakamanīyajaṭākalāpaṃ gauranirantaravibhūṣitavāmabhāgam । nārāyaṇapriya manaṅgamadāpahāraṃ vārāṇasīpurapatiṃ bhaja viśvanātham ॥ 1 vācāmagocaramameyaguṇakharūpaṃ vāgīśaviṣṇusurasektipādapīṭham । vāmena vigrahabhareṇa kalatravantaṃ vārāṇasī ...॥ 2 rāgādidoṣarahitaṃ suguṇānurāgaṃ vairāgyaśāntinilayaṃ girijāsahāyam । mādhuryadhairyanilayaṃ garalābhirāmaṃ vārāṇasī ...॥ 3 tejomayaṃ sakalaniṣkalamadvitīyamānandakandamaparājitamaprameyam । nānātmakaṃ saguṇanirguṇamādidevaṃ vārāṇasī...॥ 4 bhūtādhipaṃ bhujagapuṅgavabhūṣitāṅgaṃ vyāghrājināmbaradharaṃ jaṭilaṃ trinetram । pāśāṅkuśābhayavarapradaśūlapāṇiṃ vārāṇasī ...॥ 5 āśāṃ vihāya parihṛtya parasvanindāṃ pāpe ratiñca vinivārya manassamādhau । ādhārahṛtkamalamadhyagataṃ pareśaṃ vārāṇasī ... ॥ 6 śītāṃśuśobhitakirīṭavirājamānaṃ phālekṣaṇānalavināśitapañcabāṇam । nāgādhipāracitabhāsurakarṇapūraṃ vārāṇasī ... ॥ 7 paścānanaṃ duritamattamataṅgajānāṃ nāgāntakaṃ danujapuṅgavapannagānām । dāvānalaṃ maraṇaśokabhayāṭavīnāṃ vārāṇasī ...॥ 8 vārāṇasīpurapateḥ parameśvarasya vyāghroktamaṣṭakamidaṃ paṭhate manuṣyaḥ । vidyāśśriyaṃ vipulasaukhyamanantakīrtiṃ samprāpya dehavilaye labhate ca mokṣam ॥ 9 ॥ śrīviśveśvarāṣṭakaṃ sampūrṇam ॥
